name: Malaysia
prevalence_note: PDRM CCID (SemakMule), NSRC 997, BNM & LHDN 2025-2026: Macau Scams impersonating PDRM, LHDN tax arrears, Mahkamah warrants, MCMC/SKMM line blocks, and Pos Laju contraband parcels across Malay, Mandarin, English, and Tamil, alongside bank TAC/APK theft dominate.
cross_border_note: Cross-border scam call centers place calls in Malay, Mandarin, English, and Tamil using VoIP-spoofed +60 landline/mobile numbers and foreign prefixes; victims can check mule accounts on PDRM SemakMule and call NSRC 997.

scams.name: Penipuan Menyamar Pegawai PDRM, LHDN dan Mahkamah (Macau Scam)
scams.name_en: Fake PDRM, LHDN tax agency, and court warrant Macau Scam in Malay
scams.signals_en: Known locally as a Macau Scam, the caller poses as LHDN, court, or PDRM police alleging unpaid tax arrears, illegal company registration, or money laundering tied to the victim's MyKad.
scams.legit_en: Malaysian courts, LHDN, and Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) never transfer phone calls between enforcement agencies, issue arrest warrants via WhatsApp, or instruct citizens to move money to 'safe accounts'.
bait_tactics: Maaf tuan, garis telefon dekat kawasan perumahan saya ni tengah hujan lebat jadi putus-putus, boleh ulang nama jabatan perlahan sikit?
Saya memang bayar cukai potong gaji setiap bulan, kejap saya cari fail penyata dekat bilik belakang tapi kunci laci pula tak jumpa.
Kalau betul ada kes rasmi, biar saya pergi sendiri ke balai polis berdekatan petang nanti untuk semak laporan.

scams.name: Penipuan Sekatan Talian Telefon Menyamar MCMC / SKMM
scams.name_en: Fake MCMC / SKMM communications regulator phone line suspension scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to represent MCMC/SKMM, warning that all mobile numbers under the recipient's MyKad will be blocked within hours due to scam complaints and offering to transfer the call to fake police.
scams.legit_en: MCMC never calls individual subscribers to shut down phone lines, collect overdue bills, or transfer calls to police stations.
bait_tactics: Pelik juga sebab bil telefon saya memang potong automatik setiap bulan, nanti saya semak sendiri dalam aplikasi mudah alih saya.
Sekarang saya tengah memandu di lebuh raya, memang tak boleh salin apa-apa rujukan, hantar surat rasmi ke alamat bil sajalah.
Talian ni elok saja saya tengah guna bercakap sekarang, petang nanti saya singgah pusat khidmat pelanggan tanya sendiri.

scams.name: Penipuan Amaran Transaksi Kad Bank dan Kod TAC
scams.name_en: Fake Malaysian bank or BNM fraud alert stealing TAC codes or pushing APK installs
scams.signals_en: Impersonating a commercial bank security unit or Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM), the caller alerts the recipient to an unauthorized card charge and demands TAC/OTP codes, Secure2u/MAE approval, or WhatsApp APK installation.
scams.legit_en: Bank Negara Malaysia and commercial banks never make unsolicited calls asking customers to disclose usernames, passwords, card PINs, or TAC authorization codes.
bait_tactics: Kad bank tu ada dalam dompet saya sekarang dan saya langsung tak pernah aktifkan transaksi luar negara pun.
Kejap ya, saya letak telefon dulu dan terus hubungi sendiri talian rasmi di belakang kad bank saya untuk sahkan.
Telefon saya ni tak keluar apa-apa mesej pengesahan pun sebab liputan dalam bangunan pejabat ni sangat lemah.

scams.name: Penipuan Bungkusan Pos Laju / Kurier Mengandungi Barang Terlarang
scams.name_en: Fake Pos Laju or courier parcel contraband & police-transfer scam
scams.signals_en: Caller poses as Pos Laju or a courier company claiming a parcel under the victim's name and MyKad was intercepted containing illicit bank cards or passports, then routes the call to a fake PDRM officer.
scams.legit_en: Pos Laju and licensed couriers never investigate criminal contraband by phone or connect customer calls directly to police headquarters.
bait_tactics: Saya memang tak pernah kirim bungkusan ke negeri itu, nanti saya jalan kaki semak sendiri dekat pejabat Pos Laju.
Sekarang saya tengah sibuk di tempat kerja, kalau bungkusan tu bukan alamat rumah saya, pulangkan saja kepada pengirim asal.

scams.name: Fake PDRM / LHDN / MCMC / Pos Laju Macau Scam & Bank TAC Vishing
scams.name_en: English-language Malaysian Macau Scam posing as LHDN, MCMC, Pos Laju, PDRM, or bank TAC desk
scams.signals_en: English-speaking caller poses as LHDN tax officers, MCMC, Pos Laju, or a bank fraud desk before transferring the line to a bogus PDRM Bukit Aman investigator demanding bank TAC codes or transfers to a Bank Negara 'safe account'.
scams.legit_en: PDRM, LHDN, MCMC, Pos Laju, and Bank Negara Malaysia never transfer calls to police stations, ask for TAC/Secure2u approvals, or hold citizen funds in 'safe accounts'.
bait_tactics: Hold on, the signal in this basement carpark is breaking up—let me check my tax filing on the official MyTax portal myself tonight.
Why would Pos Laju connect me directly to a police station? Let me pause a moment and walk to the nearest district police headquarters first.

scams.name: 假冒大马警方（PDRM）／内陆税收局（LHDN）／MCMC／Pos Laju 华语澳门骗局
scams.name_en: Mandarin-language Malaysian Macau Scam posing as PDRM, LHDN, MCMC, or Pos Laju

red_flag_keywords.text: 转入国家银行安全户口

scams.signals_en: Mandarin-speaking caller targets Malaysian Chinese residents posing as LHDN, MCMC, Pos Laju, or court staff alleging tax arrears, spam SIM registration, or contraband parcels, then transfers the call to fake PDRM officers demanding 'safe account' transfers...
scams.legit_en: Malaysian government departments (PDRM, LHDN, MCMC) never conduct phone interrogations, transfer calls to police officers, or request bank TAC codes or 'safe account' transfers.
bait_tactics: 不好意思啊，我现在在巴生塞车信号很差听不清楚，你把公文寄来我家地址，我明天自己去税收局柜台问。
奇怪咧，我打工每个月都有扣税，你等我先暂停打去国家诈骗应对中心确认一下。

scams.name: PDRM / LHDN / Pos Laju மற்றும் வங்கி TAC தமிழ் தொலைபேசி மோசடி
scams.name_en: Tamil-language fake PDRM, LHDN, or Malaysian bank TAC phone scam
scams.signals_en: Tamil-speaking caller impersonates LHDN, Pos Laju, MCMC, or Malaysian bank security and threatens arrest or account freezing unless the victim shares TAC codes or transfers savings to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: PDRM, LHDN, and Bank Negara Malaysia confirm officials never connect phone calls to police investigators or request TAC codes or safe-account transfers.
bait_tactics: மன்னிக்கவும், இங்கே மழை பெய்வதால் இணைப்பு விட்டு விட்டுக் கேட்கிறது, நான் அருகிலுள்ள காவல் நிலையத்திற்கு நேரில் சென்று விசாரிக்கிறேன்.
என் வங்கி அட்டை வீட்டில் உள்ளது, நான் வங்கி கிளைக்கு நேரில் சென்று சரிபார்த்துக் கொள்கிறேன்.
